entries.title: Custom Python LSP cannot register in Zed (WONTFIX)
entries.rootCause: Zed settings.json can only override KNOWN LSPs; a pygls-based server is never started (verified on Zed 1.9.0 and 1.14.2).
entries.fix: Deprecated the LSP->MCP bridge (writer removed 2026-07-20); replaced with LspClient spawning basedpyright as a subprocess -> 3 MCP tools (lsp_find_references / lsp_find_definition / lsp_document_symbols).
entries.guard: docs/en/investigations/LSP_WONTFIX.md documents the dead end.

entries.title: ONNX migration: 7 critical bugs fixed while moving off LM Studio
entries.rootCause: LM Studio is an external process needing manual startup; the status API hardcoded 'lm_studio' as the provider, so it lied when port 1234 was closed.
entries.fix: Replaced the hardcoded provider string with a real port probe; migrated embeddings + reranking to a local ONNX Runtime; all 50 tools work in ONNX mode (v2.7.0).
entries.guard: intel_get_runtime_status now reflects the real runtime; docs/en/investigations/ONNX_SESSION_REPORT.md.

entries.title: Lock-zombie: MCP boot blocked up to 30s by a stale DB PID-lock
entries.rootCause: Boot failed closed on the DB PID-lock for up to 30s, exceeding the Zed timeout; the server was killed, the zombie stayed, and _is_pid_alive could not tell a healthy MCP from an orphan.
entries.fix: Holder classification (DEAD/HEALTHY/ORPHAN/AMBIGUOUS) with a TOCTOU guard and retry-unlink in src/core/database_lock.py; orphan self-heals in 120ms.
entries.guard: tests/test_database_lock_selfhealing.py (+17); benchmark_selfhealing.py.

entries.title: Probe script shadowed the production symbol build_call_graph
entries.rootCause: run_experiment_pagerank.py defined the same name as the production build_call_graph; the probe silently shadowed it in the graph module.
entries.fix: Renamed and gated the probe; one-off experiment scripts now live in their folder or _archive (experiments/README rule).
entries.guard: grep for name collisions before adding probes.

entries.title: Context aggregator D1-D3 defects found by the harness
entries.rootCause: Intent filters git_history/verify_change silently returned empty in the B-scheme; harness gaps (D1-D3) hid the failures.
entries.fix: Documented in KNOWN_ISSUES (yellow); re-run after the fix is planned.
entries.guard: intent coverage asserted per task in bench_v2.

entries.title: Late enrichment: imports metadata = 0.0 on search chunks
entries.rootCause: Chunks from the search pipeline (~186 tokens) carry no import metadata; enrichment at query time had nothing to add.
entries.fix: Kept behind the MSCODEBASE_LATE_ENRICHMENT flag; the finding is recorded in KNOWN_ISSUES.
entries.guard: flag stays off; the hypothesis is re-probed before enabling.

entries.title: Memory contamination: the memory layer accepts false claims
entries.rootCause: Project memory was add-only with no retraction and no validation against the code; false claims propagated into context.
entries.fix: ADR-0002 (retraction + statuses) and ADR-0003 (lazy verify-on-read); measured adoption drop 1.0 -> 0.12 -> 0.0 in experiments 1-R / 1-V.
entries.guard: tests/test_memory_retraction.py + tests/test_verify_on_read.py.

entries.title: Shadow canary fail-open: 5/5 attacks passed
entries.rootCause: The canary trusted empty responses and a failed baseline (fail-open); the quality metric was relative, so a collapse-to-constant passed.
entries.fix: Fail-closed on empty canary and baseline failure, absolute anchor _ABS_MIN_QUALITY 0.5, collapse detector (variance < 1e-3).
entries.guard: tests/test_shadow_canary.py 13/13 (realistic per-pair vectors).

entries.title: hybrid_search_async cache-hit skips the dense tier
entries.rootCause: An embedding cache hit returned early, silently skipping the vector search tier; repeat queries lost vector recall (the first multi-RAG run was fully distorted).
entries.fix: Cache isolation per arm in ablations; the production fix is tracked in KNOWN_ISSUES (hybrid-cache).
entries.guard: ablation harness must isolate the cache per arm.

entries.title: Concurrency: 0 errors did not mean correct data
entries.rootCause: Replacing a thread-safety primitive created a new race surface (shared results dict, shared correlation id, result swap between inputs) that exception-free runs do not expose.
entries.fix: Rule §2.3: results are collected per call; stress tests must verify the right input -> right output (adversarial probe EXP-7).
entries.guard: tests on result correctness under N=2 and N=8 concurrency.

entries.title: Memory v2: SUPERSEDED filter + false-retraction metric not committed
entries.rootCause: ADR-0004 cascade behavior (REFUTED propagation) was designed and validated but left uncommitted at session end.
entries.fix: Recorded as tech debt; commit planned with the next memory batch.
entries.guard: session-end checklist: commit or park experiments.

entries.title: Server unreachable during/after indexing
entries.rootCause: A sync update_all in the main loop blocked the server while indexing.
entries.fix: Moved update_all off the hot path; indexing no longer blocks tool calls.
entries.guard: get_health_report smoke after a full reindex.

entries.title: extract_anchors produced garbage anchors -> false VOR retractions
entries.rootCause: Anchor extraction over-matched identifiers, so verify-on-read retracted valid memory.
entries.fix: Tightened anchor extraction; verified against the memory dataset.
entries.guard: tests/test_verify_on_read.py (anchor quality cases).

entries.title: Reranker offline all day: PID-reuse in _is_pid_alive
entries.rootCause: A completed process object was classified as alive via PID reuse, so the reranker process was treated as running when it was dead.
entries.fix: Process-object state check before PID liveness; the reranker restarts on demand.
entries.guard: runtime status probe shows the real process state.

entries.title: Duplicate servers with two Zed windows
entries.rootCause: The lock was taken before Popen, not before port readiness; the second window started a duplicate server.
entries.fix: Lock acquisition moved after the port-readiness check; multi-window PID-lock documented.
entries.guard: KNOWN_ISSUES multi-window PID-lock entry.

entries.title: validate_scores grader: 11 holes (NaN/Infinity pass)
entries.rootCause: Type validation without value validation: NaN/Infinity passed isinstance, clamped, and earned the maximum score.
entries.fix: P-006: math.isfinite, decline on duplicates, regex path through validate_scores; mutation score 8% -> 100%.
entries.guard: tests/test_reranker.py (+13); evalmut probe in CI.

entries.title: stale_detector MCP tool: 11 false drifts
entries.rootCause: The stale detector reported drifts that were actually renames/reorders; severity_overrides has a Windows quirk.
entries.fix: Fixed the 11 false drifts; the Windows quirk stays open in KNOWN_ISSUES.
entries.guard: negative-controls runner (protocol of Tom).

entries.title: fastmcp dist-name vs import-path: 7 false REFUTED
entries.rootCause: VOR anchors (file/import/env) could not tell a dist name from an import path; the fastmcp class was retracted as absent.
entries.fix: ADR-0005: pkg: anchors from the manifest (pyproject.toml + requirements) as a closed world; 7 false REFUTED -> 0.
entries.guard: tests/test_verify_on_read.py (+7).

entries.title: CoT arm: glm-4.7 upstream EMPTY_CONTENT
entries.rootCause: In reasoning mode the upstream returns finish=stop with an empty body (reasoning_tokens ~6) for 16-26% of responses; the share is unstable between runs.
entries.fix: Documented as an upstream defect; glm CoT numbers are qualitative only; the harness retries and counts errors honestly.
entries.guard: run report flags n(err) per model.

entries.title: VOR showed token strings instead of file fragments -> recall 0.08 (anchor bias)
entries.rootCause: The VOR layer presented bare pattern tokens ('typesense') as evidence; a model honestly answers false/unknown because a token string proves nothing (diagnosed by the V4 arm file_content_first).
entries.fix: VOR must show the real file fragment around the anchor (+/-12-line window): recall(real) qwen3.6 0.08 -> 0.88, qwen3.7 0.20 -> 0.88 at FA 0.02-0.04. CORRECTED (RED TEAM on ground truth, 2026-08-15): the 'all remaining FA being present-trap (R45/R46)' phrasing was a mislabeled-data issue - R43/R45/R46/R47 are true facts, real trap-FA = 0; the corrected labels expose trap miss_true instead.
entries.guard: exp-1L V4 arm + per-category metrics on the corrected dataset (29 true / 21 false, fp e5f7373d); next gap: trap miss_true (fail-closed models lose true usage-claims).
